items.title: Ghoztty logs now show up under the right subsystem
items.text: Internal Zig errors (like "failed to initialize surface") were being logged under `com.mitchellh.ghostty`, so `log show --predicate 'subsystem == "com.dzearing.ghoztty"'` came up empty. They now land under the correct subsystem and are actually discoverable.

items.title: No more collisions with an installed upstream Ghostty
items.text: Dock tile preferences, pasteboard selection, exported file types, Quick Terminal window, Shortcuts permissions, and the fullscreen helper all used `com.mitchellh.*` identifiers and could conflict with a side-by-side Ghostty install. All renamed to `com.dzearing.*`.
